name: HandBrake
title: HandBrake: free UniConverter alternative
caption:
UniConverter charges $49.99/year to convert and shrink videos. HandBrake does it for free 🎬

✅ Presets for phones, TVs, the web and Discord-sized clips
✅ Batch queue: line up a pile of videos and walk away
✅ Outputs MP4, MKV or WebM, with H.265, H.264 and AV1
✅ Crop, deinterlace, denoise and add subtitles

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ HandBrake is built for converting and compressing, not for editing, and it only handles DVD and Blu-ray sources without copy protection. The $49.99/year is UniConverter's Windows yearly plan; Mac is $59.99

beats.say: You're paying fifty bucks a year just to shrink your videos.
And there's an app that does it for free.
UniConverter wants fifty dollars a year. HandBrake costs nothing.
Drop in a huge four K video, pick a preset, and it shrinks it down.
There are presets for your phone, your TV, even Discord.
The latest version alone got downloaded over three million times.
